next_step: Run 2-week POC: embeddings + reranker migration, run A/B + canary with eval harness; finalize security questionnaire
notes: Account background: legal discovery SaaS focused on enterprise search across litigation docs (contracts, emails, transcripts). Fast growth; large historical index (estimated 6B paragraphs / 120TB text).

Initial ask: move vector search + reranker off a bespoke pipeline to a supported inference platform. Goals: reduce 95p latency below 250ms for short queries, control cost per query (< $0.015 avg), maintain or improve relevance (precision@5).

Constraints: data residency requirement (must keep PII in customer VPC), strict audit trails for scoring decisions, and SOC2/ISO internal controls for vendor. Prefer private deployment with optional air-gapped for top customers.

Technical notes from 2025-03-05 sync: currently using in-house FAISS + custom LightGBM re-ranker. Embedding model is ad-hoc BERT-based (384d) — want to evaluate migrating to a newer embedder (768d) and moving rerank to an LLM-based cross-encoder. Concern: quality regression vs current tuned model.

POC scope agreed 2025-03-11: import 10M doc vectors (sample index ~2TB), run end-to-end compare: baseline vs Redwood embeddings+reranker. Capture embedding drift, recall@100, nDCG, latency distributions, and cost-per-query at target QPS (200 qps sustained).

Evaluation plan: use Redwood Eval harness + our in-house judge set (2k labeled queries). Will run A/B with 10% live traffic in canary stage, monitor eval metrics and manual spot checks. Must pass no-regression threshold: -1% nDCG allowed; any >1% drop triggers rollback.

Security progress: RHQ completed initial security questionnaire; security team sent SAML metadata and requested KMS integration details. Waiting on Redwood to provide HSM/KMS integration docs and audit log retention SLAs.

Operational requirements: automatic fallback to existing on-prem index if latency or quality drops; prefer canary policy with gradual ramp + automatic rollback. Need token-level cost reporting to map unit economics by route/model.
Key concerns called out by Head of Search (quote): "We cannot accept silent quality regressions — every release needs eval gates and human signoff for top customers."
Metrics target summary: 95p latency <250ms, p50 <90ms; sustain 200 qps with autoscaling; cost target <$0.015/query (embeddings+rerank amortized).
Timeline and milestones: POC kickoff 2025-03-20; POC report w/ eval results due 2025-04-03; if positive, plan pilot with 3 customers in May (canary to 10% traffic).
Action items (AE/SE): SE to share recommended quantization/profile for embeddings to reduce storage; AE to coordinate NDA + SOC2 docs; customer to provide sample index export (S3 path).

Open blockers: need estimated storage/ingest cost for 10M vectors on Dedicated vs Private; legal needs review of on-prem package license; internal ML team wants offline reproducibility of reranker scoring (logs + seed).
